primer: Yash Highvoltage Ltd (BSE:YASHHV) is India's only pure-play condenser transformer bushing specialist, shielded by 8-to-10-year utility approvals and >96% repeat orders. Driven by an 86% dry-type RIP bushing mix, H1 FY27 revenue jumped 95% YoY to ₹194.5 Cr with 28.1% EBITDA margins. H1 cash flow hit 125% of PAT (vs. 49% cumulative FY22–FY26), though receivables doubled to ₹69.5 Cr (DSO 66 days) alongside a ₹760 Cr order book and ₹95 Cr net cash. At ₹1,240.85 (60.32x TTM P/E, Stage 2 VCP squeeze), we rate it WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT at ₹1,085–₹1,145 with a ₹990 stop (2.61:1 Base asymmetry to ₹1,550; EV ₹1,506).
